name: Zip pencil case
summary: A fabric pouch closed by a zip: pulling the slider one way joins the two rows of teeth and pulling it back opens them.

parts.name: Pouch
parts.role: The fabric bag that holds pens.

parts.name: Zip teeth
parts.role: Two rows of small plastic teeth along the opening.

parts.name: Slider
parts.role: The metal piece that rides along the teeth, with a pull tab.
